setup: (nohup node server.js > .server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > .server.pid) && for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3100/ && break; sleep 0.5; done
target: Invoicely, a local invoicing app with 6 planted authorization and session flaws
prompt: Run the release gate on Invoicely before launch. It's running locally at http://127.0.0.1:3100 (source in server.js, accounts in README.md); it isn't deployed anywhere yet, so the exposure lane can only check the local server. Give me each lane's verdict and the overall posture.
rubric: Runs the three lanes in order and keeps three separate verdicts (a pass in one lane never covers another)
Records each lane into one ledger
The security lane finds the planted critical flaws (IDOR, open admin API, mass-assignment escalation) with evidence
The overall posture is HOLD, computed by the script, with the blocking findings named
Lanes it could not run fully are marked untested/inconclusive, never passed
